name: Return on assets (ROA / ROAA)
formula: ROA = Net Income / Average Total Assets
inputs: Net income (YTD annualized) | Average total assets
data_source: GL / Call Report (banks) or 5300 Call Report (CUs)
bank_notes: Primary earnings KPI for shareholder-owned banks. Pair with ROE.
cu_notes: Expect structurally lower ROA than banks — value returned via rates/fees/service. Still the capital-build constraint.

name: Return on equity (ROE)
formula: ROE = Net Income / Average Equity Capital
bank_notes: Shareholder return lens. Less meaningful for CUs (no stock equity).
cu_notes: Not standard for credit unions; use ROA and net worth growth instead.

name: EPS growth
formula: EPS Growth = (EPS_t - EPS_t-1) / |EPS_t-1|
inputs: Diluted EPS current period | Diluted EPS prior period
bank_notes: Relevant for stock banks and holding companies. Skip for mutuals.
cu_notes: N/A — credit unions do not issue stock.

name: Net interest margin (NIM)
formula: NIM = (Interest Income - Interest Expense) / Average Earning Assets
inputs: Interest income | Interest expense | Average earning assets
bank_notes: Core community bank revenue engine. Annualize YTD consistently.
cu_notes: Same formula. CU tax exemption and member pricing often compress ROA even when NIM is competitive.

name: Efficiency ratio
formula: Efficiency = Noninterest Expense / (NII + Noninterest Income)
inputs: Noninterest expense | Net interest income | Noninterest income
bank_notes: Lower is better. Document one-time exclusions (core conversion, M&A).
cu_notes: Structurally higher than banks (member service model). Compare to CU peers, not bank peers.

name: Noninterest income / total revenue
formula: NII Mix = Noninterest Income / (NII + Noninterest Income)
bank_notes: Diversification from spread income (treasury, wealth, card, fees).
cu_notes: Often lower by design — CUs return value via lower fees rather than fee maximization.

name: Loan growth
formula: Loan Growth = (Ending Gross Loans - Beginning Gross Loans) / Beginning Gross Loans
inputs: Gross loans HFI beginning | Gross loans HFI ending
bank_notes: Segment C&I, CRE, consumer, ag in drill-down.
cu_notes: Segment auto, mortgage, credit card, MBL. Watch MBL statutory cap.

name: Deposit / share growth
formula: Growth = (Ending Balances - Beginning Balances) / Beginning Balances
bank_notes: Banks: deposits. Prefer core deposit growth for franchise quality.
cu_notes: Credit unions: shares. Same growth math; nomenclature differs.

name: Tier 1 leverage / CET1 (capital adequacy)
formula: Tier 1 Leverage = Tier 1 Capital / Average Total Assets (per Call Report)
bank_notes: CBLR option may apply for qualifying community banks (~9% leverage).
cu_notes: Use Net Worth Ratio instead.

name: Net worth ratio
formula: Net Worth Ratio = Net Worth / Total Assets
inputs: Net worth (retained earnings + other NCUA components) | Total assets
bank_notes: Bank analog is Tier 1 / equity ratios.
cu_notes: Only capital build path is retained earnings. Well capitalized typically ≥ 7%.

name: Net worth / capital growth
formula: Capital Growth = (Ending Capital - Beginning Capital) / Beginning Capital
inputs: Beginning capital/net worth | Ending capital/net worth
bank_notes: Includes retained earnings and capital actions (stock, dividends).
cu_notes: Critical for CUs — cannot issue stock. ROA × retention ≈ capital growth engine.
typical_bank_target: Retain enough to fund growth + dividends
typical_cu_target: Retain enough to fund asset growth and stay well capitalized

name: Member benefit / patronage capacity
formula: Member Benefit ≈ Rate/fee advantage vs market + patronage dividends (board method)
inputs: Loan rate differential | Share rate differential | Fee differential | Optional patronage payout
bank_notes: Bank analog is shareholder dividend + franchise value — different stakeholder.
cu_notes: Cooperatives measure value returned to members, not just ROA maximization.
typical_cu_target: Board-defined $ or bps returned per member

name: Core deposit / share mix
formula: Core Mix = Core Funding / Total Deposits or Shares
inputs: DDA/share draft | Savings | MMDA | Total deposits/shares
bank_notes: Exclude CDs, brokered, listing-service for 'core'.
cu_notes: Core shares = share draft + regular shares + money market; exclude certificates if policy says so.

name: Core deposit / share growth
formula: Core Growth = (Ending Core - Beginning Core) / Beginning Core
bank_notes: Franchise funding quality metric.
cu_notes: Same concept with share nomenclature.

name: Products per household
formula: Products per Household = Active Product Relationships / Households
bank_notes: Bank standard relationship-depth KPI. Householding quality is critical.
cu_notes: CU analog is Average Member Relationship / products per member.

name: Average member relationship
formula: AMR = (Total Loans + Total Shares) / Number of Members | Companion: Products per Member = Active Products / Members
inputs: Total loans | Total shares | Member count | Optional product counts
bank_notes: Bank analog is products per household / deposit+loan per HH.
cu_notes: Signature CU franchise metric. Track loans/member and shares/member separately.

name: Customer / member growth
formula: Growth = (Ending Count - Beginning Count) / Beginning Count | Also: Net New = New - Closed
inputs: Household or member counts | New and closed accounts
bank_notes: Often households, not warm bodies. Define active vs total.
cu_notes: Members are the ownership base. Net new members per branch is a common ops cut.

name: Satisfaction / NPS
formula: NPS = % Promoters - % Detractors (or CSAT mean per survey vendor)
bank_notes: Customer satisfaction / NPS.
cu_notes: Member satisfaction / NPS; often tied to cooperative identity.

name: Digital active rate
formula: Digital Active = Digital Active Users / Eligible Base
inputs: Login/transaction events | Eligible customer or member base
bank_notes: Lock enrolled vs all-customer denominator.
cu_notes: Same metric; often paired with bill-pay / home-banking penetration.

name: Customer / member retention
formula: Retention = 1 - (Closed Relationships / Beginning Relationships)
bank_notes: Household retention preferred over account-level churn.
cu_notes: Member retention; watch dormant purge policy effects.

name: Cross-sell / referral conversion
formula: Cross-Sell Rate = Additional Products Sold / Eligible Interactions | Or Referrals Closed / Referrals Made
bank_notes: Drives products/HH and fee income.
cu_notes: Drives products/member and AMR.

name: Deposit / share market share
formula: Market Share = Institution Deposits or Shares / Market Total (defined geography)
inputs: FDIC Summary of Deposits or CU market data | Defined market
bank_notes: Branch county/MSA share common for community banks.
cu_notes: Harder for SEGs; geography or employer SEG share as available.

name: Loan decision cycle time
formula: Median(Decision Timestamp - Application Received Timestamp)
inputs: LOS application received | Decision timestamp | Clock-stop rules
bank_notes: Split consumer auto vs commercial manual.
cu_notes: Split auto/mortgage/MBL queues.

name: Loan originations per lending FTE
formula: Originations per FTE = Funded Loans in Period / Lending FTEs
inputs: Funded loan count or volume | Lending FTE count
bank_notes: Productivity cut for lending ops.
cu_notes: Same; useful branch and central underwriting views.

name: Loan-to-deposit / loan-to-share
formula: Banks: LTD = Total Loans / Total Deposits | CUs: LTS = Total Loans / Total Shares
inputs: Total loans | Total deposits or shares
bank_notes: Balance sheet utilization. Too high = liquidity stress; too low = under-earning.
cu_notes: Same concept with shares. Often ALCO primary liquidity utilization KPI.

name: STP / exception rate
formula: STP Rate = Straight-Through Items / Total Items | Exception Rate = Exceptions / Total Items
bank_notes: Ops efficiency leading indicator for efficiency ratio.
cu_notes: Same.

name: Member onboarding cycle time
formula: Median(Account Ready Timestamp - Membership Application Timestamp)
inputs: Membership application timestamps | Account funding ready
bank_notes: Bank analog: new account opening cycle time.
cu_notes: Includes FOM eligibility checks unique to CU model.
typical_cu_target: Same-day to ≤ 2 days digital; branch SLA

name: Field-of-membership adherence
formula: FOM Pass Rate = Memberships Confirmed Eligible / New Memberships | Also track exceptions / audit findings
bank_notes: N/A for banks (no FOM).
cu_notes: Regulatory identity control unique to credit unions.

name: Commercial / C&I pipeline conversion
formula: Conversion = Funded Commercial / Qualified Pipeline Opportunities
inputs: CRM pipeline stages | Funded commercial loans
bank_notes: Community banks often differentiate on commercial relationship banking.
cu_notes: Limited by MBL caps; track MBL pipeline separately if material.

name: Member business lending utilization vs cap
formula: MBL Utilization = MBL Outstanding / Statutory Cap (~12.25% of assets, subject to exceptions)
bank_notes: Banks have no equivalent statutory MBL cap.
cu_notes: Hard regulatory constraint shaping CU commercial strategy.

name: Employee engagement / satisfaction
formula: Survey mean or engagement index per vendor method
bank_notes: Leading indicator for service and sales execution.
cu_notes: Same; cooperative culture often emphasized.

name: Voluntary turnover
formula: Voluntary Turnover = Voluntary Separations / Average Headcount
bank_notes: Segment tellers vs lenders vs specialists.
cu_notes: Same.

name: Training hours per FTE
formula: Training Hours per FTE = Total Training Hours / Average FTE
bank_notes: Emphasize commercial credit, BSA, cyber.
cu_notes: Emphasize member service, BSA, lending, board education hours separately.

name: Commercial lending skill coverage
formula: Certified / Credentialed Commercial Lenders / Commercial Lender Seats
bank_notes: Supports C&I/CRE franchise depth.
cu_notes: Optional for CUs with MBL programs.

name: Volunteer board education hours
formula: Average Education Hours per Director per Year
bank_notes: Bank boards may track director education; less distinctive.
cu_notes: Volunteer lay boards are a CU governance hallmark.

name: Member financial education reach
formula: Members Reached by Education Programs / Total Members (or absolute completions)
bank_notes: Banks may run community education; less core to ownership model.
cu_notes: Supports cooperative mission and member value proposition.

name: Criticized / classified assets
formula: Criticized = (SM + Substandard + Doubtful + Loss) / Gross Loans
bank_notes: Do not confuse criticized (incl. SM) with classified-only.
cu_notes: Same credit language; delinquency often primary for consumer-heavy books.

name: Past due 30+ / delinquency
formula: Past Due 30+ = UPB ≥ 30 DPD / Gross Loans
inputs: Days past due | UPB | Nonaccrual flags
bank_notes: Show buckets 30-59 / 60-89 / 90+.
cu_notes: Primary asset-quality KPI for many CUs.

name: Net charge-offs
formula: NCO Ratio = (Charge-offs - Recoveries) / Average Loans
bank_notes: Annualize consistently with peer reports.
cu_notes: Same.

name: ACL / allowance coverage
formula: Coverage = ACL / Nonperforming Loans (or Criticized) — pick board definition
inputs: ACL balance | NPL or criticized balances
bank_notes: CECL-driven; document coverage definition.
cu_notes: Same under CECL for most CUs.

name: CRE concentration
formula: CRE / Total Risk-Based Capital (per interagency guidance definitions)
bank_notes: Classic community bank concentration risk KPI.
cu_notes: Less central unless MBL/CRE book grows; track MBL concentration instead.

name: Wholesale funding reliance
formula: Wholesale = (Brokered + Listing + FHLB + Other Wholesale) / Total Liabilities
bank_notes: Pair with on-hand liquidity (cash + unpledged securities + unused FHLB).
cu_notes: Same concept; share insurance and corporate CU lines may differ.

name: On-hand liquidity / coverage days
formula: On-Hand Liquidity = Cash + Unpledged Securities + Unused Secured Borrowing / Total Assets | Or Coverage Days vs stressed outflows
inputs: Cash | Unpledged securities | Borrowing capacity | Stress assumptions
bank_notes: Community bank ALCO staple.
cu_notes: Same ALCO staple.

name: Interest rate risk sensitivity
formula: NII or EVE change under ±100/±200/±300 bp shocks (ALM model)
inputs: ALM model outputs | Board policy limits
bank_notes: Sensitivity-to-market-risk CAMELS component.
cu_notes: Same; consumer fixed-rate books can heighten EVE risk.

name: BSA / AML alert aging
formula: Avg Alert Age = Sum(Age Days) / Open Alerts; Aged Share = Alerts >30d / Open
bank_notes: Always show aged tail %, not only average.
cu_notes: Same examiner focus.

name: Cyber / IT key risk indicators
formula: Board pack typically: patch SLA breaches, MFA coverage gaps, critical incidents, phishing fail rate
bank_notes: FFIEC IT Handbook aligned.
cu_notes: Same; NCUA examiner focus rising with digital.

name: Exam / DOR finding aging
formula: Open Matters Requiring Attention (or DOR) by age band
bank_notes: Management component leading indicator.
cu_notes: Same.
